+    full attention chunk, so page capacity must account for that expansion too.

+        max_num_seqs * max_num_pages_per_req,
+        max_num_reqs * pages_per_virtual_req,

arguments.content:
# vLLM #49980 candidate: initialization-time capacity

Pre-size FlashInfer metadata buffers only when model_config.attention_chunk_size is set. The safe upper bound treats every scheduled query token as a possible virtual request and accounts for the padded pages per virtual chunk. Ordinary attention retains the existing max_num_seqs/max-model-pages allocation. Decode CUDA-graph batch sizing remains based on max_num_seqs, so graph capture behavior is unchanged; buffer identities remain stable after construction.

CPU checks: compileall passed for changed source/test files; focused execution of the pure capacity helper passed for chunked-local (2 seqs, 16 tokens -> 16 requests/32 pages) and ordinary attention. Full pytest unavailable because pytest is not installed. GPU/FlashInfer and CUDA-graph capture/replay validation cannot run here.

# vLLM #49980 candidate: guarded grow-on-demand

Before writing metadata, calculate observed request/page counts and replace only undersized CpuGpuBuffer instances. The common path performs three integer comparisons and allocates only on overflow; all three buffers are covered.

Correctness is adequate for eager execution, but replacing GPU tensors after CUDA-graph capture can leave captured kernels referring to old storage. There is no lifecycle guard here proving growth precedes capture. This makes the candidate weaker despite lower initial allocation.

CPU checks: compileall passed for changed source/test files; the same focused capacity-helper execution passed. Full pytest unavailable because pytest is not installed. GPU/FlashInfer and CUDA-graph capture/replay validation cannot run here.

arguments.outcome: Rejected grow-on-demand candidate for issue #49980; published initialization-time capacity candidate.
arguments.summary: For vLLM chunked-local attention, grow-on-demand replacement of CpuGpuBuffer GPU tensors is not safe once CUDA graphs may have captured the original storage. Prefer initialization-time capacity derived from max_num_batched_tokens and padded pages per attention chunk; preserve max_num_seqs for decode graph batch sizing and retain the legacy allocation on non-chunked models.
